experiments.title: Pointer Light
experiments.summary: A cursor-following area light casting soft, finite shadows from extruded 2D shapes.

experiments.title: Sun & Soft Shadows
experiments.summary: Directional shadow mapping compared: hard, PCF, Poisson, PCSS, VSM and EVSM filters, texel-snapped frustum fitting and screen-space contact shadows.

experiments.title: Studio Lighting
experiments.summary: A glTF product shot lit only by its environment, with a soft shadow catcher that melts into the page.

experiments.title: Embossed Card
experiments.summary: A letterpress, embossed or foil-stamped business card on paper, steel or leather, raked by your cursor.

experiments.title: Holographic Card
experiments.summary: A foil trading card that tilts toward your cursor (or phone): diffraction rainbows, thin-film colour and brushed highlights.

experiments.title: Glass Panels
experiments.summary: Draggable frosted-glass UI cards: refraction at the bevels, real blur, colour fringing and rim light from your cursor.
experiments.background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, #ff8a3d 0%, transparent 45%), radial-gradient(circle at 75% 35%, #d83cc0 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 55% 80%, #2a7dff 0%, transparent 45%), #0b0b18

experiments.title: Radiance Cascades
experiments.summary: Paint lights and walls and watch real-time 2D global illumination: soft shadows, colour bleeding and light leaking through gaps.
experiments.background: radial-gradient(circle at 25% 35%, #ffb36b 0%, transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle at 75% 30%, #4cc3ff 0%, transparent 28%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 85%, #ff4fc8 0%, transparent 30%), #0a0b10

experiments.title: Long Shadows
experiments.summary: Flat-design long shadows for icons and type, cast in real time from your cursor using SDF sweeps.

experiments.title: Neon Sign
experiments.summary: A flickering neon sign from any text: glass tubes, white-hot cores and coloured light spilling across brick.

experiments.title: Lit Typography
experiments.summary: A real, editable HTML heading rendered as lit 3D extruded letters, with per-letter metals and shadows from your cursor.

experiments.title: Cascaded Shadows
experiments.summary: A low sun over a wooded valley: cascaded shadow maps keep shadows crisp at your feet and still there on the far hills.

experiments.title: Lantern Room
experiments.summary: A swinging candle lantern in a cut-away room: omnidirectional cube-map shadows filtered in 3D, with a dual-paraboloid comparison.

experiments.title: Spotlight & Gobo
experiments.summary: A shadow-mapped spotlight projecting a swaying cookie (leaves, blinds or a window) that follows the pointer across a wall.

experiments.title: SDF Soft Shadows
experiments.summary: A ray-marched sculpture garden with cone-traced soft shadows (analytic or baked into a 3D texture), side by side with PCSS.

experiments.title: Shadow Catcher
experiments.summary: A 3D object floating over live HTML on a transparent canvas, its soft shadow darkening real text and CSS gradients.

experiments.title: Coloured Shadows
experiments.summary: Sunlight through stained glass and tinted acrylic: a transmittance map beside the depth map, compared with stochastic transparency.

experiments.title: Blob & Baked Shadows
experiments.summary: The cheap end of shadows: soft blob decals and a lightmap baked at load, side by side with a real-time shadow map.
